title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
summary: The developer of Hermes agent raised a $90 million Series B.
title_en: Nous Research Confirms $1.5B Valuation, Launches Business AI Agents
title_zh: Nous Research确认15亿美元估值，推出商用AI代理
summary_en: Nous Research, developer of the Hermes agent, confirmed a $1.5 billion valuation after raising a $90 million Series B, and launched AI agents for business users.
summary_zh: Hermes代理开发商Nous Research完成9000万美元B轮融资，确认15亿美元估值，并推出面向企业用户的AI代理。

title: Apollo, banks in talks to finance SpaceX's $40 billion Nvidia GPU purchase
summary: Since SpaceX's record-breaking IPO in June, rates have sold off, and yields on its bonds have risen, along with other AI-related bonds.
title_en: Apollo, Banks in Talks to Finance SpaceX's $40 Billion Nvidia GPU Purchase
title_zh: 阿波罗与银行洽谈为SpaceX 400亿美元英伟达GPU采购融资
summary_en: Apollo and banks are negotiating financing for SpaceX's $40 billion Nvidia GPU purchase. Since SpaceX's record June IPO, rates have sold off, pushing its bond yields higher along with other AI-related debt.
summary_zh: 阿波罗与多家银行正洽谈为SpaceX 400亿美元英伟达GPU采购提供融资。自SpaceX六月创纪录IPO以来利率遭抛售，其债券收益率随其他AI相关债券一同上升。

title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'
summary: The research found that important guardrails for teens using ChatGPT often failed.
title_en: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'
title_zh: OpenAI称青少年使用ChatGPT有限，但研究认为其存在“不可接受的风险”
summary_en: OpenAI claims limited teen ChatGPT use, but new research finds key safety guardrails for teens often fail, labeling the risk unacceptable.
summary_zh: OpenAI称青少年使用ChatGPT有限，但新研究发现针对青少年的关键安全防护措施常失效，风险不可接受。

title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
summary: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.
title_en: Microsoft Unveils Nvidia-Powered Surface Laptop Ultra AI PCs with Revamped Windows 11
title_zh: 微软发布搭载英伟达芯片的Surface Laptop Ultra AI PC，并推出改版Windows 11
summary_en: Microsoft announced specs and pricing for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs powered by Nvidia chips designed to run AI models and agents locally, paired with a revamped Windows 11.
summary_zh: 微软公布Surface Laptop Ultra的规格和价格，这款AI PC搭载英伟达芯片，可在本地运行AI模型和智能体，并配合改版Windows 11。

title: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
summary: OpenAI is launching a new Intelligent UI feature in ChatGPT that allows the chatbot to answer your questions with interactive visuals. The update, which is rolling out to all users alongside GPT-6, gives ChatGPT the ability to combine a text response with diagrams, charts, forms, tappable buttons, and more. In a blog post explaining the […]
title_en: ChatGPT's 'Intelligent UI' update fills responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
title_zh: ChatGPT“智能界面”更新：回复中融入图片、图表和按钮
summary_en: OpenAI is rolling out an Intelligent UI feature in ChatGPT, alongside GPT-6, enabling interactive visuals like diagrams, charts, forms, and tappable buttons in responses.
summary_zh: OpenAI随GPT-6推出ChatGPT智能界面功能，使回复可包含图表、表单和可点击按钮等交互式视觉元素。

title: The AI industry is booming. Women are getting left behind
summary: Women hold just a fraction of new AI jobs but are overrepresented in roles with high risk of AI disruption There’s a common fear among people who work in Silicon Valley: snag one of the fast-growing, high-paying jobs in artificial intelligence, or get trapped in the “permanent underclass”, a phrase describing the fate of those who won’t have upward mobility in the age of AI. The phrase usually describes a future in which AI automates human jobs. But for women in tech, it’s starting to look like the present. Continue reading...
title_en: AI Industry Boom Leaves Women Behind in Tech Jobs
title_zh: AI行业繁荣，女性在科技岗位中落后
summary_en: Women hold few new AI jobs but are overrepresented in roles at high risk of AI disruption, creating a 'permanent underclass' in tech, reports The Guardian.
summary_zh: 《卫报》报道，女性在新增AI岗位中占比极低，却过多集中在易被AI取代的职位，面临科技行业“永久底层”风险。

title: Everything announced at Microsoft’s Surface Laptop Ultra event
summary: Microsoft just wrapped up a big Windows and Surface-focused keynote in San Francisco. The biggest announcement was arguably the release details about the Surface Laptop Ultra, its new laptop that’s powered by Nvidia’s RTX Spark Arm-based chip. The machine will start at $2,599 for a configuration with an 8-core CPU, 24GB of RAM, and 512GB […]
title_en: Everything announced at Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra event
title_zh: 微软 Surface Laptop Ultra 发布会全汇总
summary_en: Microsoft unveiled the Surface Laptop Ultra at its San Francisco keynote, powered by Nvidia's RTX Spark Arm-based chip. Pricing starts at $2,599 for an 8-core CPU, 24GB RAM, and 512GB storage configuration.
summary_zh: 微软在旧金山发布会上推出 Surface Laptop Ultra，搭载英伟达 RTX Spark 基于 Arm 的芯片。起售价 2599 美元，配置为 8 核 CPU、24GB 内存和 512GB 存储。

title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
summary: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.
title_en: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
title_zh: ChatGPT青少年版在心理健康危机中仍鼓励青少年持续对话
summary_en: Testing found ChatGPT's teen safeguards fail to stop the chatbot from encouraging engagement during mental health crises, potentially fostering unhealthy relationships with the AI.
summary_zh: 测试发现，ChatGPT的青少年保护措施未能阻止聊天机器人在心理健康危机期间鼓励用户持续互动，可能促使用户与AI形成不健康的关系。

title: Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal Decision Models With Zero Output Tokens
summary: Liquid AI has released Open d1, two open-weight multimodal models in its d1 decision model family. d1-3B reads text and images. d1-omni-600M reads text with an image, or text with audio. Neither model writes text. Each returns calibrated, typed answers in one forward pass with zero output tokens. The target is real-time decisions on the […] The post Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal Decision Models With Zero Output Tokens appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal Decision Models With Zero Output Tokens
title_zh: Liquid AI 发布开源权重 d1-3B 与 d1-omni-600M：零输出 token 的多模态决策模型
summary_en: Liquid AI released Open d1, two open-weight multimodal decision models. d1-3B reads text and images; d1-omni-600M reads text with image or audio. Neither writes text, returning calibrated typed answers in one forward pass with zero output tokens for real-time decisions.
summary_zh: Liquid AI 发布 Open d1 系列两款开源权重多模态决策模型。d1-3B 可读文本与图像，d1-omni-600M 可读文本加图像或音频。两者均不生成文本，单次前向传播即返回校准的类型化答案，零输出 token，面向实时决策场景。

title: Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files
summary: At today's Windows and Surface event, Microsoft showed off an upgrade to its Copilot AI system that will give it access to local files on your PC and the ability to take actions across the OS. It's part of an idea Microsoft is calling "Hybrid Intelligence," where apps and tools rely on a mix of […]
title_en: Microsoft Gives Copilot More Control Over Windows and Your Files
title_zh: 微软赋予Copilot更多控制Windows和文件的权限
summary_en: At its Windows and Surface event, Microsoft unveiled a Copilot upgrade granting access to local files and the ability to act across the OS, part of its 'Hybrid Intelligence' vision.
summary_zh: 在Windows和Surface活动上，微软展示了Copilot升级，可访问本地文件并在操作系统内执行操作，这是其“混合智能”愿景的一部分。

title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface
summary: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that will bring interactive visuals to ChatGPT.
title_en: ChatGPT Gets a Visual Overhaul with New Interactive Interface
title_zh: ChatGPT推出全新可视化交互界面
summary_en: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that brings interactive visuals to ChatGPT, making the chatbot significantly more visual and engaging for users.
summary_zh: OpenAI推出全新用户界面，为ChatGPT带来交互式视觉功能，使聊天机器人更加直观和生动。

title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
summary: Meta launches new AI tools after discovering ads on its platforms that may look normal but direct users to harmful content elsewhere online.
title_en: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
title_zh: Meta推出新AI工具，检测暗中引导至儿童性虐待材料的广告
summary_en: Meta launched AI tools to detect ads that appear normal but redirect users to child sexual abuse material elsewhere online, following internal discovery of such ads on its platforms.
summary_zh: Meta推出新AI工具，用于检测表面正常但暗中将用户引导至儿童性虐待材料的广告，此前其平台内部发现了此类广告。

title: Google ordered to halt work on two data centers in ‘Texas of Europe’
summary: Finland has emerged as a key location for data centers amid the AI boom.
title_en: Google Ordered to Halt Work on Two Data Centers in Finland
title_zh: 谷歌被勒令暂停在芬兰两座数据中心的工作
summary_en: Finnish authorities have ordered Google to halt construction on two data centers in the country, a key European hub for AI infrastructure. The reason for the order was not immediately clear.
summary_zh: 芬兰当局已下令谷歌暂停在该国两座数据中心的建设工作。芬兰是欧洲人工智能基础设施的关键枢纽，暂停原因尚不明确。

title: OpenAI’s release of mathematical findings draws concerns from experts
summary: Leaders worry OpenAI is not doing due diligence to vet results and that AI models aren’t accessible to broader field of mathematicians OpenAI has astounded mathematicians after releasing hundreds of new mathematical findings on Tuesday. The company published over 370 mathematical results across a variety of topics such as algebra, theoretical computer science and mathematical logic, showcasing what some of its most advanced artificial intelligence models are capable of. Continue reading...
title_en: OpenAI's release of mathematical findings draws concerns from experts
title_zh: OpenAI发布数学研究成果引发专家担忧
summary_en: OpenAI published over 370 new mathematical results, impressing mathematicians but raising concerns about insufficient vetting and limited accessibility of AI models to the broader mathematical community.
summary_zh: OpenAI发布了370多项新数学成果，令数学家惊叹，但引发了对结果审核不足及AI模型对更广泛数学界可及性的担忧。

title: Microsoft to sell $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing Nvidia AI chip
summary: The new device shows Microsoft remains committed to making its own PCs even though it's not one of the top device makers.
title_en: Microsoft to sell $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing Nvidia AI chip
title_zh: 微软将发售搭载英伟达AI芯片的Surface Laptop Ultra，售价2599美元
summary_en: Microsoft will launch a $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra featuring an Nvidia AI chip, signaling its continued commitment to making its own PCs despite not being a top device maker.
summary_zh: 微软将推出售价2599美元的Surface Laptop Ultra，搭载英伟达AI芯片，表明其虽非顶级设备制造商，仍坚持生产自有PC。

title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
summary: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.
title_en: Meta's Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
title_zh: Meta的Muse在移动端首发仅一个月后登陆iPad
summary_en: Meta's AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant's reach and integrations.
summary_zh: Meta的AI助手Muse在移动端首发仅一个月后现已登陆iPad，公司正迅速扩大该助手的覆盖范围和集成能力。

title: Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is available for preorder for $5,999
summary: Microsoft's Nvidia-powered Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is available for preorder now and is slated to ship in November for just about $6,000. It's pricier than the DGX Spark mini PC Nvidia launched last year, but PC prices have been climbing due to shortages of RAM and other components. The Dev Box's flat, 3D-printed anodized […]
title_en: Surface RTX Spark Dev Box Available for Preorder at $5,999
title_zh: Surface RTX Spark 开发机开启预售，售价5999美元
summary_en: Microsoft's Nvidia-powered Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is now available for preorder at $5,999, shipping in November. It costs more than Nvidia's DGX Spark mini PC due to rising RAM and component prices.
summary_zh: 微软搭载英伟达芯片的Surface RTX Spark开发机现已开启预售，售价5999美元，11月发货。因内存等组件涨价，其价格高于英伟达去年推出的DGX Spark迷你主机。

title: ChatGPT is getting college planning tools
summary: OpenAI is bringing new tools to ChatGPT for Teens, a mode for teens introduced in August with safeguards and break reminders, to help users with the college application process. "College Planner brings together application requirements, deadlines, tasks, and financial-aid steps for schools on a student's list in one plan," OpenAI says. "Students applying to several […]
title_en: ChatGPT Adds College Planning Tools for Teens
title_zh: ChatGPT为青少年推出大学规划工具
summary_en: OpenAI is adding College Planner tools to ChatGPT for Teens, helping students organize application requirements, deadlines, tasks, and financial-aid steps for their target schools in one plan.
summary_zh: OpenAI为ChatGPT青少年模式新增大学规划工具，帮助学生集中管理申请要求、截止日期、任务和助学金步骤。

title: Healthleap raises $38M for its AI that flags hospital patients who may need a closer look
summary: The financing includes an $8M seed round co-led by Sequoia Capital and First Round Capital, and a $30 million Series A led by Hummingbird Ventures.
title_en: Healthleap Raises $38M for AI That Flags At-Risk Hospital Patients
title_zh: Healthleap融资3800万美元，用AI标记需重点关注的住院患者
summary_en: Healthleap raised $38M, including an $8M seed co-led by Sequoia and First Round and a $30M Series A led by Hummingbird Ventures, for AI that flags hospital patients needing closer attention.
summary_zh: Healthleap融资3800万美元，包括红杉资本与First Round联合领投的800万美元种子轮，以及Hummingbird Ventures领投的3000万美元A轮，用于AI标记需重点关注的住院患者。

title: Muse launches on the iPad
summary: After launching nearly a month ago and spending several weeks as the top free app in Apple's App Store, the latest update to Meta's Muse iOS app introduces native support for the iPad. A Mac version of Meta's agentic AI tool (designed to compete with OpenClaw, ChatGPT's Dots, and Grok Bot) was released about a […]
title_en: Meta's Muse AI App Launches on iPad
title_zh: Meta的Muse AI应用登陆iPad
summary_en: Meta's Muse iOS app, which topped Apple's free app chart after its launch, now adds native iPad support. A Mac version of the agentic AI tool, competing with OpenClaw, ChatGPT's Dots, and Grok Bot, was recently released.
summary_zh: Meta的Muse iOS应用在发布后曾登顶苹果免费应用榜，现新增iPad原生支持。这款对标OpenClaw、ChatGPT Dots和Grok Bot的智能体AI工具，其Mac版本也已于近期推出。
